title: pyenv clone tag and expected SHA in setup-pyenv must be bumped together
answers: setup-pyenv fails with pyenv SHA mismatch error
how do I upgrade pyenv in the CI action
model serving tests cannot build Python 3.10.21 or 3.11.16 via pyenv
pyenv version bump in GitHub Actions
body:
Symptom: CI job fails early in the pyenv setup with a 'pyenv SHA mismatch' error, so model-serving environment recreation never starts.
Root cause: .github/actions/setup-pyenv/action.yml (Linux step) pins pyenv twice: the tag in `git clone --branch vX` and the `expected_sha` that is compared against `git rev-parse HEAD` after the clone.
Fix pattern: when moving the tag, replace both values in the same change, and take the SHA the tag resolves to in pyenv/pyenv. Confirm the new pyenv release ships build definitions for every Python micro version that setup-python pins, because pyenv install fails for versions it does not know.
Constraints: the clone is retried up to 3 times, but a SHA mismatch is not retried and exits with ::error::. Changing only the tag or only the SHA always breaks the job.
applies: Changes to the pyenv version used by the setup-pyenv composite action on Linux.
says: Continuous integration pipelines fail during environment setup before model serving tests can run.
Pull request builds fail immediately with checksum mismatch errors during Python environment preparation.
Automated test jobs cannot install newly supported Python maintenance releases for serving tests.
Fix build pipeline crashes caused by mismatched version tags during automated test initialization.
search: Updates to pyenv in the Linux setup-pyenv composite action must simultaneously bump the git clone tag and expected_sha in .github/actions/setup-pyenv/action.yml. The expected_sha must match git rev-parse HEAD for the tag in pyenv/pyenv, and the pyenv release must include build definitions for every Python micro version pinned in .github/actions/setup-python/action.yml. Changing only the tag or only the SHA causes an immediate unretried SHA mismatch failure exiting with ::error::.
